name: Sóskút (Hungary)
description: Light blue field charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Sóskút: a quartered yellow, blue, green and red shield with a patriarchal cross, fleurs-de-lis, a ploughshare and ears of grain.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
